description:
A visit to the Rotary Club of London offered an opportunity to experience the fellowship and traditions of one of Rotary’s oldest Clubs. The meeting was held at the Chesterfield Mayfair Hotel in Westminster. The meeting was attended by representatives of the R7 Clubs, representing
Rotary Clubs from seven European capitals. The speaker was Major General Sir Evelyn Webb- Carter, Vice-Chairman of the Memorial Gates
Foundation. He spoke about the Memorial Gates. The meeting followed a format similar to that of the Rotary Club of Bombay, with a few distinctive traditions. Visiting Rotarians who wished to speak about their Clubs or share their personal experiences were invited to address the gathering. The visit also included a banner exchange, providing an opportunity to strengthen the bonds of fellowship between the two Clubs.
